# Twelve Data

Twelve Data provides a comprehensive financial data API offering real-time and historical market data for stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, ETFs, and indices.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/twelve-data/.

## Actions

- **Currency Conversion** (read-only): Convert an amount from one currency to another.
- **Dividends** (read-only): Retrieve dividend payout history for a specified symbol.
- **Earnings** (read-only): Retrieve earnings data including eps estimates and actuals.
- **ETFS Directory** (read-only): Fetch a daily updated list of exchange-traded funds sorted by total assets.
- **List Commodities** (read-only): Retrieve a list of supported commodities.
- **List Cryptocurrencies** (read-only): List all supported cryptocurrencies.
- **List market indices** (read-only): Retrieve a list of market indices.
- **List Stocks** (read-only): Retrieve a list of stocks.
- **List supported exchanges** (read-only): Retrieve a list of supported exchanges.
- **List supported forex pairs** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all supported forex currency pairs.
- **Mutual Funds List** (read-only): Retrieve a daily updated list of mutual funds sorted by total assets.
- **Options Chain** (read-only): Retrieve the options chain for a given symbol and optional expiration date.
- **Options Expiration** (read-only): Retrieve available option expiration dates.
- **Quote** (read-only): Retrieve the latest market data for a specified symbol.
- **Symbol Search** (read-only): Search for financial instruments by symbol or company name.
- **Technical Indicators** (read-only): Fetch time-series data for a specific technical indicator.
- **Time Series** (read-only): Retrieve historical and real-time time series data for a specified symbol.
- **EPS Revisions** (read-only): Provide analysts’ revisions of a company’s future eps over the last week and month.
- **EPS Trend** (read-only): Retrieve historical eps trends for a specified company.
- **ETFS Family** (read-only): Fetch a comprehensive list of etfs by family.
- **Get ETF Types** (read-only): Retrieve etf categories by market, including types like 'equity precious metals'.
- **Mutual Funds Family** (read-only): List all available mutual fund families.
